# Vendored viewer libraries (pinned)

Loaded by `preview.js` from this folder; the desktop CSP forbids CDNs. To upgrade, replace
a folder with the new version's files, rename the folder, update the path constants at the
top of `preview.js` and the table in `NOTICE.md`.

| Folder | Source |
|---|---|
| `pdfjs-4.10.38/` | npm `pdfjs-dist@4.10.38`: `build/pdf.min.mjs`, `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`, `web/pdf_viewer.mjs`, `web/pdf_viewer.css`, `web/images/`, `cmaps/`, `standard_fonts/`, `LICENSE` |
| `docx-preview-0.4.1/` | npm `docx-preview@0.4.1`: `dist/docx-preview.min.js`, `LICENSE` |
| `jszip-3.10.1/` | npm `jszip@3.10.1`: `dist/jszip.min.js`, `LICENSE.markdown` |
| `xlsx-0.20.3/` | `https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz`: `dist/xlsx.core.min.js`, `LICENSE` |
